source.method: git archive HEAD package; tar extraction

sandbox.reason: Task-owned loopback listen denied with EPERM

findings: Per-export acknowledgement state avoids concurrent exports sharing a progress counter.
Recursive and outer chunk splits propagate the same progress record; partial failures become nonretryable for default pipeline policy.
HTTP acknowledgement timeout is nonretryable with delivery unknown, without claiming remote rollback.
Existing response-aborted and socket-error retry policy remains; this is not exactly-once delivery.
reviewedTests: HTTP acknowledgement timeout reports uncertain delivery without repeating the request
a failed split export does not make the pipeline replay its acknowledged prefix
